exams.name: Apple Teacher
exams.blurb: Free professional learning programme recognising educators who complete skill quizzes on iPad and Mac productivity and creativity apps.

exams.name: Teaching English as a Foreign Language Certification
exams.blurb: Umbrella term for accredited English teaching courses, most commonly 120 hours, used to qualify for teaching posts abroad and online.

exams.name: TESOL Core Certificate Program
exams.blurb: Blended certificate from the professional association covering English language teaching foundations plus a practicum with a mentor.
